    • addUnconsumedBodyDiscard

      @Internal public static void addUnconsumedBodyDiscard(@NonNull @NonNull HttpRequest<?> request, @NonNull @NonNull Runnable discard)
      Register an action that discards a streaming body argument the route does not consume. Argument binders that claim the request body before the route executes (e.g. for a Publisher or InputStream argument) use this so that the body is not left buffered, and the connection stalled, when the request is rejected, e.g. because another argument fails to bind or a @Valid constraint is violated, or when the route returns without ever subscribing to the argument. The action must leave a body alone that the route has started to consume.
      Parameters:
      request - The request
      discard - The action that discards the body

    • addUnconsumedBodyDiscard

      @Internal public static void addUnconsumedBodyDiscard(@NonNull @NonNull HttpRequest<?> request, @NonNull @NonNull Runnable onRouteFailure, @NonNull @NonNull Runnable afterResponse)
      Register the actions that discard a streaming body argument the route does not consume.
      Parameters:
      request - The request
      onRouteFailure - The action that discards the body if the route fails before it returns
      afterResponse - The action that discards the body once the response has been written, if the route never started to consume it

    • discardUnconsumedBodies

      @Internal public static void discardUnconsumedBodies(@NonNull @NonNull HttpRequest<?> request)
      Run the actions registered with addUnconsumedBodyDiscard(io.micronaut.http.HttpRequest<?>, java.lang.Runnable). This is called when the route is not invoked, or its invocation throws, for a request whose arguments were (partially) bound. Each registration runs at most once.
      Parameters:
      request - The request

    • discardUnsubscribedBodies
